transaction_manifest.title: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free source-repaired sentinel native-boot proof

node.title: Source-repaired sentinel native-boot proof

notes: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority permitted exactly one provider-free sentinel-only native boot.
The sole process lease is consumed and no retry, worker, model, provider or network authority remains open.
No product, data, deployment, Pages or protected-ref authority opened.

decisions.summary: Accept the exact sentinel_activated event as proof that the one-byte source repair survives native Harness loading.
Accept native_process_exited_before_readiness as the sanitized one-attempt terminal, not a passing boot, with no retry or reclassification.
Accept zero broker, worker, model, provider and network activity plus exact process, raw-state and distinct-root cleanup.
Permit only a separately frozen provider-free static diagnosis of the post-sentinel, pre-stock-readiness native exit coordinate.
Accept six corrected construction, binding, selection, human-report and clockwork-ownership observations with none open.

claim_scope: The source-repaired sentinel emitted exactly sentinel_activated in one provider-free rc7 native process.
The process exited with code 1 before stock_headless_hmr_ready and the result is failed_closed, not pass.
Exactly one native process ran, no retry occurred and raw streams, environment, copied package tree and disposable root were destroyed.
No runner, broker, worker, prompt, tool, model, provider, network, Docker or database activity occurred.
The result narrows the next diagnosis to post-sentinel activation and pre-stock-headless readiness; it is not DeepSeek worker or model performance evidence.
unresolved_gates: The exact post-sentinel cause of native exit is not yet diagnosed.
stock_headless_hmr_ready has not been observed from the source-repaired profile.
No second process or retry is authorised for the consumed attempt.
No runner, broker, worker, model/provider request or EMR4 product development work is admitted by this result.

journey.strategic_role: Establish whether the repaired sentinel reaches stock-headless readiness without involving a worker or provider
journey.outcome: The sentinel activated in one traceable native process, then the process failed closed before stock-headless readiness with complete cleanup.

current_position.strategic_role: Diagnose the post-sentinel, pre-stock-readiness exit without consuming another process
current_position.why_now: Sentinel activation proves the source repair works while the sanitized native exit proves a distinct later failure surface remains.
current_position.outcome: A process-free source diagnosis will bind the narrowest evidenced exit coordinate or bounded hypotheses and decide whether any separately authorised repair or rehearsal is justified.
unlocks: A grounded explanation of the native exit window after sentinel activation.
A narrow future decision about whether one source repair or differently instrumented rehearsal is justified.
does_not_solve: No retry, second native process, broker, worker, model or provider request.
No product work, data use, deployment or protected integration.
current_position.orientation_statement: Freeze one provider-free, process-free diagnosis of the exact rc7 path between sentinel activation and stock-headless readiness while preserving the consumed terminal and raw-stream boundary.

next_operation.active_tranche: DeepSeek native Harness provider-free post-sentinel pre-stock-readiness exit-coordinate diagnosis
next_operation.objective: Perform one provider-free, process-free static diagnosis of the source-repaired rc7 Harness path after sentinel_activated and before stock_headless_hmr_ready, bind the narrowest evidenced exit coordinate or bounded hypotheses from exact pinned source and sanitized retained evidence, preserve the consumed attempt and raw-stream boundary, and launch no Node, Harness, broker, worker, model, provider or network activity.
next_operation.authority_source: Yuri's standing uninterrupted-development authority, constrained by the accepted consumed failed-closed terminal and a static provider-free diagnostic envelope.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A reused loader must bind the fresh contract path even when the predecessor function captured its old default at definition time.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first wrapper changed the engine globals but load_contract() still read the predecessor contract through its bound default path, so five dedicated tests and direct check rejected the schema label.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Provider-free pytest and direct deterministic admission failed before Node, Harness or provider activity.

correction.action: Install a fresh wrapper loader that always supplies the fresh contract path explicitly.
correction.prevention_control: Audit definition-time default arguments whenever a successor wrapper mutates reused module globals.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected inherited default contract path and explicit fresh loader binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The fresh operation must allocate under a distinct disposable-root prefix frozen by its plan.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first committed wrapper reused the predecessor engine's hard-coded dsh-repaired-sentinel-boot prefix.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: A final plan-to-controller audit found the mismatch before preexecution receipt generation and before the sole Popen.

correction.action: Install a checked fresh-prefix proxy and expose the exact prefix in deterministic admission.
correction.prevention_control: Treat disposable namespace as a first-class successor-wrapper binding alongside paths, schemas and attempt IDs.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected predecessor disposable namespace and deterministic fresh-prefix control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Git reference evidence must come only from the structured latch and machine snapshot, with no manually repeated object ID in prose.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preexecution runtime state repeated the full latch source object ID in git_refs_and_worktree prose.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The preflight returned revision_required with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden and a count of one; all attempt outputs remained absent.

correction.action: Remove the prose object ID and delegate identity to the structured source_head and machine Git snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: Git-evidence prose names fields and relations only; object values remain machine projected.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected prose Git-ID duplication and machine-only evidence binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The widened successor packet must reuse the already established exclusion of predecessor digest selectors frozen before the accepted source repair.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first widened packet repeated the prior selection lapse and included two predecessor digest selectors, which failed only at component_digest_mismatch for the repaired profile controller.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest reported exactly those two historical failures; all four applicable predecessor selectors then passed with 67 current/surrounding selectors.

correction.action: Bind the two exact selectors in a new preservation-aware historical selection and pass all remaining applicable tests.
correction.prevention_control: Make the historical selection artifact an input to command-manifest construction instead of relying on conversational recall.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the repeated historical-selector lapse and command-manifest selection binding.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A failed-closed human report must state that readiness was not reached and must never grammatically imply a passing readiness result.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The generic report boundary sentence named sentinel loading and stock-headless readiness together without result-dependent grammar, despite the structured terminal correctly recording readiness false.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Manual closeout comparison of the Markdown report to the immutable structured terminal caught the overbroad sentence.

correction.action: Render an explicit result-dependent outcome sentence and correct the retained Markdown without altering terminal evidence.
correction.prevention_control: Every terminal report template must branch human outcome wording on pass versus failed_closed and test the retained sentence.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the corrected failed-closed human wording and result-dependent report control.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A clockwork-owned active latch must remain byte-bound to the current generation until a clockwork transaction publishes its successor.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Two direct checkpoint commits kept the latch schema and ancestry valid but changed its bytes without advancing the clockwork generation manifest, so the first closeout dry run rejected canonical_drift.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The governance clockwork stopped during live-state validation before transaction preparation or publication; restoring the generated latch returned canonical drift zero.

correction.action: Restore the exact generated latch, verify canonical drift zero and let closeout clockwork own the successor transition.
correction.prevention_control: Record in-progress checkpoints in receipts; never edit a clockwork-owned canonical latch outside a clockwork transaction.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected direct canonical latch checkpoints and exclusive clockwork transition ownership.
